podcast.title: Orange County Gigs
podcast.body: Soy DeSant began playing regular gigs around Orange County, establishing themselves in the local music scene during Scott Weiland's teenage years. "And the band also began playing some regular gigs around Orange County."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Scott Weiland's Post-Punk Band
podcast.body: After being inspired by an art rock band, Scott Weiland formed his own post-punk band named Soy DeSant. The French name, meaning "a style of one's own," was a nod to Depeche Mode, one of Weiland's favorite bands. "That inspired Scott to form his own post punk band that he called Soy DeSant, which translated means a style of one's own."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Scott Weiland's Teenage Influence
xref.body: Depeche Mode was one of Scott Weiland's favorite bands during his teenage years. Their use of a French name for their band inspired Weiland to give his own post-punk band, Soy DeSant, a French name ("a style of one's own"). "Remember Scott was a Depeche Mode fan and if they could have a French name, so could his band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
